messages.text: Hi, I had questions yesterday about DB level for Kbox 22TH and see if I could benefit from a rebate on this item. I was supposed to have an answer this morning. Thank you (email hidden)
Handed to the team · Chasing a promised reply on dB figures and a pricing/rebate request; neither is

Sorry you're still waiting, Florian. I've pinged both sides again: JD for the measured dB at each KBOX preset, and Georges on the pricing question, since a rebate isn't mine to give. They're on now, so stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here, and if you step away the answer goes to (email hidden)

I see you're on the KBeast 50 TH/s at $999 too. Want me to line it up against the KBOX on power and value per TH while you wait?
KBeast won’t deliver before december correct? vs. Kbox 22Th is on stock correct?
Read the gekkoscience kbeast 50 th s page
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page

Right on both counts, Florian. The K. is a pre-order, ships December 1, 2026, and it's $999 (listed against $1,199). The K. at $800 is the one that's live and buyable now, though it's not off-the-shelf instant: it runs about a 19-day lead time from order.

So KBOX is weeks, KBeast is December. Spec-wise the KBeast is 50 TH at 800W versus 22 TH at 330W, so roughly the same efficiency, just a bigger unit.

Want me to set up a KBOX checkout?

Yes, small price difference between the two. That’s why I am trying to see if I could have a rebate on Kbox 22TH. I am also interested in Hammer DC08 ($500ish 12 TH) but I do not think you have it for BTC / BCH

You're right, Florian, our DC08 is the Scrypt unit, 480 MH/s for Doge and Litecoin, so it's no use for BTC or BCH.

On the rebate, that one sits with Georges and he has your request with this chat on it; he's on now, so he can answer right here. I can't move the $800 myself.

For BTC near that budget the live option is the Thor P2, 10 TH/s at $369. Half the KBOX hashrate for under half the price. Want the numbers side by side?
Ok, I’ll wait for George to be online or answer from him @ (email hidden)

Understood, Florian. He has it with your email on it and he's on now, so the answer comes either here or to (email hidden) A copy of this chat lands there too once we're done.

Quick one while you wait, so Georges has the full picture: is this going in a living space where noise matters, or somewhere you can put it out of earshot?
Yes noise matters. I know it won’t be fully silent. I already have Bitaxe and Apollo 3. Trying to understand where Kbox 22TH stands vs. these guys from a DB perspective

Honestly, Florian, the listing publishes no dB figure and I won't invent one, which is why JD's measured numbers are still the thing you're waiting on.

What I can say by physics: the KBOX pushes 330W through two speed-controlled fans in a sealed metal case, so it's clearly louder than a Bitaxe and in the same family as an Apollo under full load, quieter as you step down to the 16TH and 10TH presets. Fan noise tracks the watts.

Is it a bedroom or an office?

In an office it's workable, but I'd plan on running it at Medium (16TH) or Low (10TH) while you're in the room, and High when you're not. The presets are user editable, so you can tune it rather than live with one setting.

Also worth knowing: 330W is 330W of heat into that room. Fine in winter, less fun in summer.

I've noted the office use on JD's dB request so his numbers come back per preset. Anything else on the unit?
